name: Moon Blade
description: A compact elven blade carried alongside the longer Greenshield-pattern sword for close-line work and dense-terrain engagements. Forged to elven metallurgy standards and balanced for the cut-and-thrust technique Greenshield doctrine emphasizes at shorter reach. The name reflects the pale sheen the blade takes under moonlight — a property of the forging rather than an enchantment.
narrative_effects: Supports disciplined cutting and thrusting in close melee with elven Greenshield balance.
Rare in realm-side hands; its presence on a non-elf signals either long-term elven relationship or a trophy whose provenance is worth asking about.
